concept.title: i-Pedal
concept.shortdesc: i-Pedal is controlled using the accelerator pedal. It allows vehicle speed to be controlled without using the paddle shifters manually.

li.p: Pull the left side () of the paddle shifter for more than approximately 1 second at any regenerative braking level.
i-Pedal will be activated and () indicator will appear on the instrument cluster.
Pull the left side () of the paddle shifter again for more than approximately 1 second while i-Pedal is activated.
i-Pedal will be deactivated and () indicator will turn off on the instrument cluster.
When i-Pedal is deactivated, () indicator on the instrument cluster will turn gray.
When i-Pedal is activated, () indicator on the instrument cluster will turn green.
After restarting while i-Pedal is available, the regenerative braking level is maintained and turns back on. If the regenerative braking level is at 0, it will turn on at level 1.
Select Electric Vehiclei-PEDAL from the infotainment system whether to use i-Pedal while reversing.

If Disable i-PEDAL when Reversing is selected, i-Pedal will turn off when shifting into R (Reverse), and it will automatically turn on once the vehicle is shifted to D (Drive) and driving above 20 km/h (12 mph).
If Disable i-PEDAL when Reversing is not selected, i-Pedal will automatically turn on when shifting into D (Drive) or R (Reverse).
Steep uphill or downhill roads
The point where the slope ends
When repeatedly starting and stopping on a sloped road
When Downhill Brake Control (DBC) is active
The vehicle may not stop depending on the vehicle and road conditions. Always check the road conditions and driving status ahead, and if necessary, use the brake pedal to manually control the speed.
Always keep an eye on the road ahead while driving with i-Pedal.
In case of an emergency stop, use the brake pedal to stop the vehicle.
Do not use i-Pedal on slippery surfaces, as it may lead to an accident.

note.p: The regenerative braking level cannot be changed using the paddle shifter in the following cases:

li.p: Both the left () and right () side of the paddle shifters are pulled simultaneously.
Smart Cruise Control (SCC) is active.
The vehicle’s high-voltage battery is fully charged (100%) and regenerative braking is continued.
When a trailer is attached.
